== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is a massive, empty realm characterized by darkness and madness. It serves as the home of the [[Elders]] and is widely believed to be the place from which they originate. The [[Great Elders]] utilize this dimension as a means of communication and for traveling between different worlds in pursuit of various goals, such as knowledge, change, or absolute nothingness. While some ancient scholars theorized that the void connects different worlds, this remains unproven. In the physical world, the void can be accessed through rifts in the sky that are held open by the power of [[Great Elders]]. These openings appear as dark cracks or slashes in reality, through which travelers or entities like the [[Elderspawn]] can emerge.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void manifests as a realm of darkness capable of swallowing all awareness and is visible through holes in the reality of the sky. Messengers have utilized this space to carry [[Jerri]] toward the Capital. While drifting together within the void, [[Calder]] and Ozriel experienced its depths, where [[Jerri]] eventually found support beneath her feet from a stone.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Messengers carried [[Jerri]] through their void to the Capital.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is a place of darkness that can swallow awareness.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] and Ozriel drift together in the void.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is a place where [[Jerri]]'s feet were supported by a stone.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is visible through the holes in reality in the sky.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
